name: Humuson Complex
taglines: Home Of Healthy Soil & Healthy Crop
Agricultural technology for Southern Africa — balanced crop nutrition, biostimulants and soil biology from renowned European producers
Humuson Complex – Agricultural Technology & Crop Nutrition
about:
Zimbabwe’s economy is agro-based and its agricultural produce heavily depends on fertilisers for increased crop production. However, the agriculture industry has been heavily dominated by chemical fertilisers which weakened productivity of the soil, hence the need for organic fertilisers to restore the soil among other benefits. Humuson Complex was birthed upon realising a gap in the inconsistency and inadequate supply of organic fertilisers in Zimbabwe.

That gap was the starting point rather than the limit. Humuson Complex now supplies a complete nutrition programme — liquid and solid fertilisers, micronutrients, amino acids, biostimulants and soil microbiology — from established European producers, and pairs it with agronomists who match the product to the crop, the soil and the growth stage.

Our Vision: To be the partner of choice for modern agricultural technology in Zimbabwe and beyond — advancing precision agriculture, balanced crop nutrition and biological innovation for farming that is profitable, resilient and sustainable.

Our Mission: To bring the Southern African market the technologies that raise yield without costing the soil — balanced crop nutrition, biostimulants and soil biology, matched to each crop and growth stage and supported by agronomists in the field.
